subject.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache invalidation

question: Should this draft land independently, or should its leaf-identity and cache-dependency fixes be combined with the overlapping ancestry work in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2113?
rationale: Both patches appear useful in isolation but modify overlapping identity and parent-resolution semantics; repository intent is needed to select the canonical landing sequence or combined implementation.

options.title: Combine the fixes
options.body: Reconcile both branches into one change set with a single identity and ancestry contract and retain all relevant regressions.

options.title: Sequence independent merges
options.body: Choose one PR first, then rebase and re-review the other against the merged semantics before landing it.

options.title: Land this PR only
options.body: Accept this branch as the sufficient current fix and leave the broader ancestry work tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Combine the fixes
recommendation.body: Reconcile both branches into one change set with a single identity and ancestry contract and retain all relevant regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available owner for choosing the canonical landing path between overlapping open PRs.
